tests.name: Stats reflect zero activity for a player who never fired
tests.why: Catches implementations that return 404 or crash on players with no game history instead of returning zeroed stats.

tests.name: Fire at out-of-bounds coordinates on active game
tests.why: Ensures coordinate bounds are validated before inserting into the moves table, preventing corrupt game state.

tests.name: Fourth player cannot join a 3-player game
tests.why: Verifies max_players capacity enforcement so a full lobby correctly rejects late arrivals.

tests.name: Reject fire request with a missing authentication header
tests.why: Confirms protected endpoints are consistently enforcing authentication and do not allow unauthenticated game actions to slip through.

tests.name: Fire twice at the same cell in the same game
tests.why: Catches implementations that fail to track prior moves correctly and allow duplicate shots that would corrupt game stats.
